mentions.claim_text: He sees missiles filling the sky and smoke coming out of Poland going into Russia, then breaks into praying in tongues.
mentions.quote: I see the smoke from it coming out of Poland going into Russia
mentions.falsify_match: Missiles are launched from Polish territory into Russia.

mentions.claim_text: He repeats the sequence he says he was shown: the war starts up, then the plague, with Russia rising and the black horse riding.
mentions.quote: the war start up and then the plague
mentions.falsify_match: A major war is followed by a pandemic in that order.
mentions.falsify_miss: Neither arrives, or they arrive in the other order.

mentions.claim_text: He sees Belarus carrying a Russian flag and trying to join up with Russia, with Turkey named alongside, in what will be with North Korea and Russia.
mentions.quote: I see Belarus with a Russia flag. They'll try to join up with Russia
mentions.falsify_match: Belarus enters the war formally on Russia's side.
mentions.falsify_miss: Belarus stays a host and supplier without entering. Note Belarus has been Russia's closest ally throughout, so the bar for a match is formal co-belligerence.

mentions.claim_text: He tells the audience to look around at the acceleration of events every day, repeating the acceleration he says he was told about.
mentions.quote: The acceleration of events every day
mentions.falsify_match: Events continue to compound at an unusual rate.
mentions.falsify_miss: Nothing here can fail; any news flow satisfies it.

mentions.claim_text: He sees Japan involved in an attack together with South Korea and North Korea, centred on a border he cannot orient, saying he is not familiar with the area.
mentions.quote: I see you trying to be an attack with South Korea and North Korea
mentions.falsify_match: An armed incident on the Korean border drawing Japan in.

mentions.claim_text: He works out aloud that the border he sees is the part closest to China, which he settles on as the upper west, and sees a disturbance there.
mentions.quote: it's the closest to China
mentions.falsify_match: A disturbance on the North Korea to China border.

mentions.claim_text: He sees Japan and South Korea drawn in over Russia and North Korea joining the fight with NATO, and sees something to do with boats, ships and major cargo.
mentions.quote: I see something to do with boats, ships, major ships, cargo
mentions.falsify_match: A maritime shipping incident involving Japan or South Korea and North Korea.

mentions.claim_text: He says the North Korean leader is about to come out of his basement and come up to the top, seen with something black.
mentions.quote: Little Kim's about to come out of his basement
mentions.falsify_match: Kim Jong-un takes a prominent public international role.
mentions.falsify_miss: He stays out of view. Note he has appeared at foreign summits repeatedly since 2024.

mentions.claim_text: He says a major war is trying to break out in Poland and in Warsaw as a battlefront, and that it is not about taking land but about war itself and about currency.
mentions.quote: Try to break out in Warsaw. I see it being a major front
mentions.falsify_match: Fighting opens on Polish territory.

mentions.claim_text: He prays over the president's towers and buildings in New York, saying he sees his towers burning again, and names the 41st floor, the New York subways and Times Square as places he sees explosions.
mentions.quote: I see his towers burning. I see the 41st floor in New York
mentions.falsify_match: A fire or explosion at a Trump property in New York involving the 41st floor.

mentions.claim_text: He names the New York subways and Times Square as places he sees explosions going off, calls every plot to nothing, and prays over Boston and Chicago.
mentions.quote: I see explosions going there
mentions.falsify_match: An explosive attack on the New York subway or Times Square.

mentions.claim_text: He describes a detailed vision of great confusion coming to certain airline industries, naming an American carrier, aimed at making people afraid to fly, and a major bank whose name starts with an A.
mentions.quote: trying to get people to be afraid to fly
mentions.falsify_match: A disruption to American air travel severe enough to change flying behaviour.

mentions.claim_text: He describes people unable to get money out because the computers were down, with every ATM at one bank completely black in a cyber attack and people panicking.
mentions.quote: all the ATMs at the certain bank were completely black
mentions.falsify_match: A cyber attack takes one American bank's ATM network fully offline.

mentions.claim_text: He says darkness is coming on Cuba, that he saw it and it has already happened, that he does not know whether it was cyber, and that the mules left during the darkness.
mentions.quote: there's darkness coming on Cuba. I saw darkness on it
mentions.falsify_match: A nationwide Cuban blackout. Note Cuba has had repeated grid-wide collapses since October 2024, so this is a low bar.

mentions.claim_text: He points to a major earthquake in Japan that day and says the Lord warned them about a week earlier, on the 17th, when he saw the water heating up.
mentions.quote: we have a major earthquake today in Japan
mentions.falsify_match: A major Japanese earthquake within days of the stated warning.
mentions.falsify_miss: No Japanese earthquake in that window.

mentions.claim_text: He says he told the audience they were just days away from a major event in Japan, and repeats a prayer for Seattle, Portland and British Columbia because he saw thirty thousand people die.
mentions.quote: I said, Watch Japan. So we pray for Seattle, Portland
mentions.falsify_match: A Pacific Northwest earthquake killing tens of thousands.

mentions.claim_text: He gives a word that God is shaking the church, Israel and America, and shaking false religion, with false temples and what he calls monkey temples coming to the ground.
mentions.quote: Shakings in false temples, false gods, temples
mentions.falsify_match: Ancient temples in Asia destroyed by earthquakes.

mentions.claim_text: He contrasts American churches at three hundred years old with thousand year old temples that will fall, and notes a 7.1 magnitude earthquake struck southern Japan that day.
mentions.quote: They're going to be thousand-year old temples that fall
mentions.falsify_match: Thousand year old Asian temples brought down by earthquakes.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such collapses. Note Japan records roughly one or two magnitude 7 events a year, so a 7.1 alone is not unusual.

mentions.claim_text: He restates that he saw Turkey beating its war drums and going alongside Russia, with the black horse riding and a major uprising of war in Europe, and tells the audience to watch Europe.
mentions.quote: I saw them going alongside Russia and I saw the black horse riding
mentions.falsify_match: Turkey aligns with Russia and a general European war begins.
mentions.falsify_miss: Turkey stays in NATO and no European war begins.

mentions.claim_text: He recalls saying that when Israel strikes Syria, Turkey will send ground invasion troops from the north wearing red hats, coming against Israel in the days ahead.
mentions.quote: Turkey will send ground invasion troops
mentions.falsify_match: Turkish ground troops enter Syria against Israel after an Israeli strike.

mentions.claim_text: He repeats that another Katrina is coming, that it depends on how America handles Israel, and adds that this one will hit Mar-a-Lago.
mentions.quote: This one will hit Mar-a-Lago
mentions.falsify_match: A Katrina scale hurricane strikes Palm Beach and Mar-a-Lago.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such storm hits that location.

mentions.claim_text: He asks prayer for the president's family, naming Barron, Don Jr, Ivanka and Kai as prominent in the vision and Eric as less so, alongside a report that Melania and Barron were targeted by Iran.
mentions.quote: Kai was huge in the vision
mentions.falsify_match: An attempt against a named member of the president's family.

mentions.claim_text: On a report of another blank check signed in Washington and Patriot air defence going to Ukraine, he says this is the France material he gave in the last two videos.
mentions.quote: They signed over another blank check
mentions.falsify_match: France and America supply advanced missiles and air defence to Ukraine.

mentions.claim_text: He says human sacrifice and what he saw behind closed doors brings in that spirit, that the children are tied up and they want them, and that the Lord said to watch Berlin.
mentions.quote: And the Lord said, Watch Berlin
mentions.falsify_match: A major event or exposure centred on Berlin.

mentions.claim_text: He plays footage from China of police drones flashing sirens at night to order swimmers out of the water, given as an example of the surveillance coming.
mentions.quote: they send a drone over your head and they flash sirens
mentions.falsify_match: Drone-based public enforcement spreads to Western countries.

mentions.claim_text: He says Facebook took him down and will not allow him to post new content, that they told him they did not want him there, and that this is the platform suppression he warned about.
mentions.quote: They banned me. They said, We don't want you over here
mentions.falsify_match: The account is confirmed removed or restricted.
mentions.falsify_miss: The account is active and posting.

mentions.claim_text: He warns the church to sift what it is hearing, saying that those telling people good days are coming in America are giving an itching-ear word as in Jeremiah's day.
mentions.quote: they're giving you an itching ear word
mentions.falsify_match: America enters a period of hardship rather than the good days others promise.
mentions.falsify_miss: America enters a period of prosperity, which would also falsify his own reprieve claims.

mentions.claim_text: He points to a report that North Korea will send Russia thirty thousand soldiers as what the Lord warned him about, referring back to the train he says he saw.
mentions.quote: First, North Korea will send Russia 30,000 soldiers
mentions.falsify_match: A further thirty thousand North Korean troops are confirmed sent to Russia.

mentions.claim_text: He says he was grieved because these men had never had the chance to hear the gospel, and that the enemy's plan was to push untrained men to the front so better trained soldiers did not have to risk their lives.
mentions.quote: push these men up front so that the other men didn't have to
mentions.falsify_match: Reports confirm untrained North Korean conscripts used as first-wave infantry.
mentions.falsify_miss: North Korean units are reported as trained and effective.

mentions.claim_text: He plays a clip of an official stating a readiness to supply Turkey with a million barrels of crude oil a day so that the region is not dependent on anyone else.
mentions.quote: 1 million barrels of crude oil every single day
mentions.falsify_match: The supply arrangement is signed and volumes flow.

mentions.claim_text: He says God is setting up South America for a great revival, sees a man with a beard and names Colombia, and mentions a shifting coming in England.
mentions.quote: Setting up South America for a great revival
mentions.falsify_match: A recognised revival movement across South America centred on Colombia.

mentions.claim_text: He prays over the American oil reserves, naming Houston and Louisiana as targets for strategic sabotage intended to disrupt the economy and tip it into a 1930s style crash.
mentions.quote: strategic attacks sabotage on our oil reserves
mentions.falsify_match: Sabotage against American oil reserve infrastructure in those states.

mentions.claim_text: He declares that the Clarity Act and the Save America Act passed and will pass, and prays for a strong Iraqi currency.
mentions.quote: the clarity and Save America act passed. It will pass
mentions.falsify_match: Both acts are signed into law.
mentions.falsify_miss: Either act fails. Note he says passed and will pass in the same breath, which covers both states.

mentions.claim_text: He says tithers and givers have the right to rebuke the devourer because the Lord already rebuked it, and asks whether God can trust them with little before making them ruler over much.
mentions.quote: You have tither's rights
mentions.falsify_match: Tithers are visibly spared in the downturn he predicts.
mentions.falsify_miss: Tithers fare the same as everyone else. The condition makes any shortfall attributable to the giver.

mentions.claim_text: He says Jewish people will be so persecuted in certain cities and towns that they will uproot and return to Israel, with great antisemitism blaming them for gas prices.
mentions.quote: they'll uproot themselves out of where they are and go back to Israel
mentions.falsify_match: A measurable wave of Jewish emigration from American cities to Israel.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw heavy things and a shaking of America, and that the Lord told him to read Jeremiah 24 concerning the nation of America.
mentions.quote: I want you to read Jeremiah 24 concerning the nation of America
mentions.falsify_match: A national reversal for America matching the good and bad figs division.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw a Judas rising up concerning the midterms, heard the instruction to activate the cells in Detroit and Philadelphia and to activate the mosque, and heard of major distractions raised for the midterms.
mentions.quote: I saw them activating the cells in Detroit
mentions.falsify_match: A coordinated attack or disruption in Detroit or Philadelphia around the midterms.
mentions.falsify_miss: The midterms pass without such an event.

mentions.claim_text: He sees multiple drones, perhaps a hundred at once, coming out of Cuba to hit Miami and other areas, with a fog and a storm over Miami that he could not see through.
mentions.quote: Multiple drones at one time coming out of Cuba to hit Miami
mentions.falsify_match: A mass drone attack on Miami launched from Cuba.

mentions.claim_text: He says the drone operators knew it was a suicide run and would do it anyway, on the reasoning that if they cannot have the land nobody will, and that he saw Iran acting as a kamikaze escalating the war.
mentions.quote: if we can't have it their land, no one will
mentions.falsify_match: Iran launches an attack it knows to be suicidal, escalating the war.

mentions.claim_text: On a report that Russia wants another thirty thousand North Korean troops, he says he told them North Korea would join up with Russia and that when they did he saw a major world war across Europe because Europe had become hostile.
mentions.quote: North Korea will join up with Russia in the days ahead
mentions.falsify_match: A general European war follows further North Korean deployments.
mentions.falsify_miss: The deployments continue without a wider war.

mentions.claim_text: He shows a Russian petrol station queue as fulfilment of a word about gas lines over a mile long in the days ahead, noting the Russian people are having a hard time.
mentions.quote: gas lines that would be over a mile long in the days ahead
mentions.falsify_match: Fuel queues over a mile long recorded.

mentions.claim_text: He says weapons never seen before are about to be used, which he calls a flex, describing tactical EMPs rather than large ones, designed and perfected to work on a limited specific area.
mentions.quote: weapons that we've never seen before that are about to be used
mentions.falsify_match: A tactical electromagnetic pulse weapon is used in combat.

mentions.claim_text: He says a window would have closed had it not been done at a certain time, that he saw two angels making military personnel invisible to get them through, and that the Lord showed him again a splitting of chemical weapons.
mentions.quote: I saw two of them helping them get through this by being invisible
mentions.falsify_match: A special forces operation succeeds against expectation and is later reported.
mentions.falsify_miss: Nothing here can be checked; the mechanism claimed is invisibility.

mentions.claim_text: He says a chemical spray would be released just behind a barrage of missiles and drones so that the barrage is the distraction, and that the same plan was prepared for Israel.
mentions.quote: they would be right behind the barrage
mentions.falsify_match: A chemical agent is released alongside a missile or drone barrage.
mentions.falsify_miss: No chemical attack of that pattern.

mentions.claim_text: Shown footage of oil facilities burning around the world, he identifies them as oil wells in Saudi Arabia and remarks on the scale of it.
mentions.quote: Look at all these oil facilities burning around the world
mentions.falsify_match: Confirmed fires at Saudi oil installations.
mentions.falsify_miss: The footage is old or from elsewhere. He says himself he is not sure it is recent.

mentions.claim_text: He asks the audience whether oil will ever reach two hundred dollars a barrel, whether it will be manipulated to stay under, or whether it will be a short window after all the facilities are destroyed.
mentions.quote: Do you all believe that we'll ever see $200 a barrel
mentions.falsify_match: Brent or WTI trades above two hundred dollars.
mentions.falsify_miss: Oil stays well below that. He is now asking rather than asserting, which softens the standing claim.

mentions.claim_text: He plays the president calling a lawsuit unpatriotic and saying the ballroom project is moving fast, ahead of schedule and on budget, and that no country has anything like it.
mentions.quote: We're ahead of schedule. We're right on budget
mentions.falsify_match: The ballroom is completed on the stated schedule.
mentions.falsify_miss: The project is delayed or abandoned.

mentions.claim_text: He says the president's legacy will be that he is known as a wartime president with a ballroom, recalls praying him through the ear injury and the re-election, and repeats the word pride holding people back.
mentions.quote: he'll be known as a wartime president with a ballroom
mentions.falsify_match: The presidency is remembered primarily for a war.

mentions.claim_text: He prays angels around American special forces, Navy Seals and special units, calling them protected from every direction and asking that nobody be lost that day.
mentions.quote: We put angels around our special forces
mentions.falsify_match: No American special forces casualties in the period.

mentions.claim_text: He says what is about to take place in Ukraine and Russia is more serious than Iran, that Putin is devising a plan and putting it into motion, and that something tragic is about to be seen concerning him.
mentions.quote: Putin is devising a plan and he's putting this plan into motion
mentions.falsify_match: A major Russian escalation or a tragedy involving Putin.
mentions.falsify_miss: Nothing changes in the Russian position.

mentions.claim_text: Working out a country from a map, he settles on Belarus and says Belarus is backstabbing, will help Putin, and that deals are being made.
mentions.quote: So Belarus is backstabbing. They're going to help Putin
mentions.falsify_match: Belarus takes an active part in operations against Ukraine or Poland.
mentions.falsify_miss: Belarus remains a host state only.

mentions.claim_text: He sees France, England, Germany and Italy, with Germany and Italy faded, and says France and England are doing something together, the new prime minister and Macron like two peas in a pod.
mentions.quote: France and England are doing something
mentions.falsify_match: A France and Britain initiative on Ukraine that Germany and Italy stay out of.

mentions.claim_text: He names four men and four countries together: England, Canada, France and the United Kingdom, with Carney named among them.
mentions.quote: I see these four men. England, Canada, France
mentions.falsify_match: Those four leaders form a bloc on the war.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such grouping forms. Note he lists England and the United Kingdom as two of the four.

mentions.claim_text: He says he has been in Europe the whole time in the spirit, and sees a major storm trying to break forth into a war all over Europe like a world war, with major alignments.
mentions.quote: I see a major war trying to break forth all over Europe
mentions.falsify_match: A general European war begins.

mentions.claim_text: He says the black horse and its rider are coming out of Russia and riding from east to west across Europe, correcting his own direction mid-sentence.
mentions.quote: The black horse is riding from the east to the west in Europe
mentions.falsify_match: Famine or scarcity spreads westward across Europe out of the Russian war.
